nexu-io-openmotion-agents-add-byok-provi.description: Add or maintain a built-in BYOK media provider in the OpenMotion repository, including official API research, credentials, model discovery, generation adapters, editor configuration, provider references and verification. Use for contributor requests to integrate a supplier; ordinary media generation uses the openmotion-media Skill.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-br.description: OpenMotion — Prepare a reusable Brandkit and motion-design brief from user-supplied brand facts, assets and references. Use when organizing brand context for a video, not for rendering or editing a project.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-de.description: OpenMotion — Adapt one of six bundled motion compositions using its MOTION_DESIGN.md, preserving timing and movement while replacing the user's copy. Use for these source-backed examples or as a concrete pattern for a reusable motion design package.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-director.description: Plan and create original motion videos and motion graphics with OpenMotion. Use for “做一个 motion 视频”、动效视频、动画短片、先构思视频怎么呈现, including esports recaps, explainers, product demos and brand films. Also use for narrative, motion or sound redesign and creative review. Execute established edits/exports with openmotion-production, editable templates with openmotion-template-to-video, reference reconstruction with openmotion-recreate and reusable templates with openmotion-video-to-template. Repository development does not trigger video production.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-gr.description: OpenMotion — Reverse-engineer how a company grew and turn it into a sourced growth-map video. Use when someone names a company (a competitor, a breakout startup, their own product) and asks how it grew, what moves drove its growth, for a growth teardown, growth timeline or "copy how X grows". Produces dated, cited growth moves on the metric curve, three plays worth copying and a 1920×1080 motion film rendered from editable HyperFrames source.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-media.description: Generate, poll and inspect individual image, video, speech or music assets through openmotion_assets_use after openmotion_media_use discovery (configured Atlas Cloud, fal.ai, WaveSpeedAI or OpenDesign Cloud BYOK providers, or a signed-in OpenDesign account), either when delegated by an OpenMotion film workflow or for a standalone asset-generation request. Native-only tasks with no new speech or music stay outside generation unless explicitly requested. Not a whole-film entry point: creating, recreating, templating, editing or exporting a whole video belongs to the OpenMotion video entries.

nexu-io-openmotion-codex-plugin-onboardi.description: Show the welcome and three embedded project-preview cards; accept automatic MCP activation separately.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-pr.description: OpenMotion — Adapt presenter-led videos using reusable motion design recipes for listicles, workflow demonstrations and product walkthroughs. Use with the creator's own footage and measured speech timing to combine spoken storytelling, captions, screen recordings and motion.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-production.description: 执行 OpenMotion 已有工程在既定创作决定下的局部修改、素材或音轨替换、预览、技术排错、导出与交付。重新设计叙事、动作或声画关系使用 openmotion-director；已有模板出片走 openmotion-template-to-video，参考作品复刻走 openmotion-recreate，视频转可复用模板走 openmotion-video-to-template。仓库开发与文档维护不触发影片制作。

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-recreate.description: Recreate a reference video (a link or file) as the user's own film with OpenMotion: rebuild it as an editable OpenMotion project and hand it over open in the editor, keeping the original content or swapping in the user's copy, brand and assets. This includes small edits to the user's own finished video when no editable project for it exists. "Make one like this" and "I want this feel" both count as recreation. In a workspace with the user's product material, a bare link alone means "make one like this for us". References that also contain portraits, product photography, live-action or AI…

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-reference-.description: OpenMotion 原生 Hyperframes 编写的兼容入口，供旧引用继续使用。新的视频任务按本轮意图进入相应专业 Skill，工程操作复用 openmotion-production；本入口不承担专门的视频复刻分析。

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-template-t.description: Browse, compare and recommend OpenMotion catalog templates with a visible library preview, or make a video from an existing editable template, project folder, ZIP or selected gallery source. Preserve agreed motion and content; resume existing work. Video-only references use openmotion-recreate; reusable template production uses openmotion-video-to-template.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-video-to-t.description: 使用 OpenMotion 将参考动效视频或链接重建为可反复换内容的可编辑模板，交付源码、素材、预览、编辑说明与文件夹或 ZIP。仅在用户要求可复用模板时使用；按参考制作本次成片走 openmotion-recreate，使用已有模板出片或替换内容走 openmotion-template-to-video，原创走 openmotion-director。

nexu-io-openmotion-motion-package-exampl.description: Adapt the Product Story recipe to a supplied product or lesson brief using its visual identity, three-scene rhythm and input limits. Use when the user selects this package or asks to adapt its recipe.
